OrcaWave

OrcaWave supports diffraction analysis and hydrodynamic data generation for floating structures.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Prepare a diffraction model

Use the vessel geometry, loading basis and selected design condition. In the intended OrcaWave preview, prepare a diffraction model; the visible result is a hull or system model with principal dimensions and compartments visible. Review coordinate system, displacement, openings and watertight intent before accepting or exporting it.

Define wave headings and periods

Start from the environmental case, analysis settings and operating assumptions. In the intended OrcaWave preview, define wave headings and periods; the visible result is hydrostatic, hydrodynamic or structural results tied to the vessel state. Review criteria, headings, periods, load transfer and solver validity before accepting or exporting it.

Review hydrodynamic coefficients

Begin with the compared design cases and reporting template. In the intended OrcaWave preview, review hydrodynamic coefficients; the visible result is a traceable performance, production or stability package. Review margins, units, condition identity and naval-architecture judgement before accepting or exporting it.
